reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD has its own workbench tool bars and enables tools from its BarCtx state; there is no Matrix Top 11 catalogue.
Selection is QymCAD document-model state, not an OM9 ObjectId set with document stamps.
The curve edits are sketch-entity operations tied to QymCAD's Project/Id model.

rationale: QymCAD split/trim tools are sketch/part workbench states; the portable curve join/split/trim kernels are OM9's curve_ops, already measured under OM9-L2-02-04.
not_reused: QymCAD BarCtx/Hand UI state and its sketch Id document model.
QymCAD native/OCCT adapters; the Top 11 are host command adapters over OM9's document.
l3_scope: Explode a polycurve, join an unordered curve selection, split a target at every intersection with one or more picked cutting objects (curve, NURBS surface or BRep), and trim the portion picked on the target. The default build asks OCCT for exact curve/face intersections; the no-default developer build refuses a BRep cutter because it has no exact kernel path. CMD fraction forms remain available. Every action is one transaction with Undo/Redo.
